statement:
The invoice record indicates that invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite displaying a status of unpaid and due.
Invoice 88412 has been placed on hold because the payment history shows it was already paid in full on September 3 (reference PAY-2291), preventing a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the "unpaid, due" status is wrong because the invoice "was already paid in full on September 3 (reference PAY-2291)," and holds payment to prevent a duplicate.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
